message: fix(connection): handle the cancelled receive race during shutdown
purpose: All compact-card, merchant-boundary, native layout and server sale checks passed, but live verification exposed ClientWebSocket.ReceiveAsync throwing ObjectDisposedException after DisconnectAsync cancelled and aborted the socket. Treat that exception as expected only when the receiver cancellation token is already cancelled. Do not swallow errors during an active session or suppress protocol errors. Add deterministic filter checks and repeated real reconnects after sale. Preserve every old assertion, timeout, sale result and persistence requirement.
